decisions.reason: The dumper draws on the vehicle and dump-truck know-how from the mining line, which helps the firm read early results and improve the product, but it was only mentioned on the website and the related mining products were already dropped, so its future is uncertain.
The inclined furniture lift sits at the core of the firm's lift know-how and had its own page, so the firm can interpret its results and keep developing it.
The building material lift shares technology and customers with the furniture lift, so it builds directly on related knowledge the firm can use to refine it.
The truck-mounted version combines the firm's lift expertise with its vehicle know-how, giving it the related knowledge needed to assimilate market feedback.
